import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.drop_duplicates(subset=['penguin_id'], keep='first')
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.strip()
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    allowed_islands = ['Biscoe', 'Dream', 'Torgersen']
    df = df[df['island'].isin(allowed_islands)]
    df = df[(df['flipper_length_mm'] >= 170) & (df['flipper_length_mm'] <= 235)]
    df = df[(df['body_mass_g'] >= 2500) & (df['body_mass_g'] <= 6500)]
    df = df[(df['bill_length_mm'] >= 30) & (df['bill_length_mm'] <= 60)]
    df = df[(df['bill_depth_mm'] >= 13.2) & (df['bill_depth_mm'] <= 21.2)]
    df = df[(df['year'] >= 2007) & (df['year'] <= 2009)]
    return df

def answer(df):
    return df['island'].value_counts().to_dict()
